headline: Pritchard goes ballistic as Celtics dismantle the Bulls at the Garden
morning_brew: I was at the Garden on Friday night and man, that was exactly the kind of kick in the pants we needed. Payton Pritchard was an absolute force, dropping thirty points and making the Bulls look like they were playing in skates. It wasn't just the buckets either, the whole vibe felt like a team that's finally shifting into gear. I haven't seen a guy hunt for his shot like that since cousin Jimmy tried to cut the line at the North End bakery on a Sunday morning.

It is wicked nice to see the bench depth actually showing up because we are gonna need everyone firing on all cylinders with the schedule getting tougher. Jayson Tatum added a solid twenty-six, but the way Pritchard snatched the spotlight in the backcourt was the story of the night. If the C's keep playing this kind of unselfish hoops and keep the defensive intensity this high, they are gonna be a total nightmare for anyone visiting our building.

Looking ahead to Saturday, we have the Bruins back on the ice for a matinee against the Blackhawks. I am expecting a massive bounce-back effort from the boys after that rough showing in St. Louis earlier in the week. Puck drop is at one, and I will be there hoping to see the B's dictate the pace and snag two points in front of the home crowd.

news_digest.headline: Pritchard nets 30, Celtics ease past turnover-prone Bulls 125-111 in NBA Cup action
news_digest.dans_take: That is how you start a tournament, total dominance from start to finish.
